Inputs13

CalendarNewA month calendar for single dates, continuous ranges or multiple picks. Months slide in from the direction you travel (chevrons or a swipe), the title flips to a month / year grid, selected days pop with a spring and ranges draw one band with rounded ends that wraps across weeks. Locale-aware weekday and month names via Intl, Sunday or Monday weeks, min / max / custom disabled days, a today ring, coloured event dots and whole-day colour highlights. Day tiles follow the kit radius — square at 0, circles from 16 up.5 variants
Date PickerNewA date field with a floating label and glowing focus halo that opens the Calendar in a spring sheet (drag the grabber to dismiss, a dialog on wide screens) or an anchored popover. Single or range mode, one-tap presets like Next 7 days and Next weekend, optional Clear / Done staging with a live summary, Intl formatting, error shake with an icon message and a success check.4 variants
Flip CalendarNewA date picker that's a top-bound desk calendar: lift a page and it turns up over the rings toward you in 3D, its plain back showing once it passes upright, with the next day underneath; pull down and yesterday's page swings back over the top onto the pad. The page stays under your finger the whole way, a flick finishes the turn and a hard flick turns several days. Each page has a month band, a huge day number (Sundays in the accent), the weekday and a day-of-year / week footer.1 variants
Floating InputThe label starts as the placeholder and glides onto the border when you focus — a soft accent halo blooms around the field, errors shake in with an icon, valid values pop a spring check. Prefix/suffix, clear button, counter and three variants whose indicator grows from the centre.8 variants
OTP InputOne-time-code cells that size themselves to fit any width. The active cell glows with a soft focus halo and a blinking caret, digits pop in on a spring, a pasted code fills every cell, errors shake the row and success pulses across the cells with a drawn check.5 variants
Password InputFloating-label password field with an eye / eye-off toggle that cross-fades and spins, a spring-filled strength meter that shifts colour with the score, a live requirements checklist that ticks itself off, and a confirm mode that says when passwords match.5 variants
Sign in to try it live
Ruler Time PickerProNewA time or date picker you actually want to drag: scrub or fling a tick ruler and every piece of the big value rolls to its next one with a motion blur. Ticks swell in a bell around the needle, the bump trails your drag, and it snaps to a step when you let go — with a selection haptic on every tick. mode="date" makes each tick a day, marks the 1st of every month and pulls back like a rubber band past min / max dates.2 variants
Search BarSearch field with a soft focus halo: the magnifier pops on focus, Cancel slides in as the field springs narrower, the clear button scales in and a spinning arc shows loading. Suggestions drop down in an animated panel with recent / trending icons and the matching text in bold; a trailing slot fits a filter or mic button. The minimal variant expands from a round icon.5 variants
SelectA form field with a floating label and a glowing focus halo that opens a dropdown anchored right under it — matching its width, preferring below, flipping above only when there's clearly no room, re-placing itself on resize / rotation / keyboard, and scrolling inside when long — or, with presentation="sheet", a drag-to-dismiss bottom sheet (a dialog on wide screens). The chevron turns, rows carry icons, descriptions, groups and disabled states, the chosen row gets a springy accent check, search highlights matches with a "No results" state, multiple mode adds checkboxes and removable chips that pop in and collapse out smoothly (overflow rolls into a "+N" chip, the footer count rolls too), and on web arrow keys, Enter and Escape drive the menu.7 variants
SliderA slider that feels native on iPhone and Android: thumb and fill ride the native driver, the thumb swells under your finger, tap the track to seek, and values spring-snap to the step. Thin iOS track, a Control-Center style bar with an icon that inverts as the fill passes, a stepped track with ticks, and two-thumb range mode with an optional histogram.6 variants
StepperQuantity control whose number rolls — each changed digit slides out as the new one slides in, up or down with the change. Airbnb-style outline, an iOS-style filled capsule, a compact row control, and a DoorDash-style cart button that springs open from a single + into − 1 + (with a trash can at 1). Buttons spring on press, hold to repeat with acceleration, and pushing past a limit gives a little bump.7 variants
TextareaMultiline field that glides taller line by line between minRows and maxRows, with a floating label, a focus halo, animated error / success states, a counter that morphs into a progress ring (amber at 90%, red at the limit) and a toolbar slot for chat composers.6 variants
Time PickerNewTime input in three styles: iOS-style wheel drums whose rows tilt, shrink and fade past an inset selection band (scroll-driven on the native driver, momentum snapping, tap a row to jump); a Material 3-style clock face with a big hh : mm header, AM / PM toggle and a hand you drag anywhere on the dial — it snaps to hours, then crossfades to minutes; or a grid of bookable time chips with struck-through booked slots and Morning / Afternoon / Evening groups. Render any of them inline or as a floating-label field that opens it in a drag-to-dismiss sheet.6 variants

Selection6

CheckboxThe tick draws itself in, the box squishes on press and a ring bursts out. Labels, descriptions and to-do strike-through.4 variants
Chip GroupFilter chips for single or multiple choice. A check mark draws itself in while the chip widens smoothly to make room and its colours cross-fade. Wrapping or horizontally scrolling.5 variants
Radio GroupPick one of many. The dot springs in with a ripple, selectable cards light their border and pop a check badge that draws itself, and the grouped iOS-style list draws a tick beside the chosen row.5 variants
Sign in to try it live
RatingProStar or heart rating you can tap or drag across (touch and mouse), with half-star precision. Icons fill smoothly, pop in a quick stagger with a wobble, and the top one throws a spark burst; read-only mode renders any fraction.5 variants
Segmented ControlA liquid indicator: the leading edge springs ahead and the trailing edge catches up, so it stretches between segments — measured with onLayout to fit any label. Drag the selected segment to scrub. iOS pill, tab underline and outline looks, with icons and three sizes.6 variants
SwitchA toggle whose thumb stretches toward the other side while you hold it (squash & stretch), drags across under your finger and throws a soft halo as it springs over, while the track cross-fades. iOS, Material 3 and sun/moon icon looks.5 variants

Buttons6

ButtonSpring press feedback, eleven variants — including a two-tone gradient, a coloured glow and an elevated surface — four sizes, icons and a loading state. Pass any colour and every tinted variant follows it.6 variants
Sign in to try it live
Floating Action ButtonProCorner FAB in a solid accent fill with a matching glow. Tapping it fans out a staggered speed dial — a labelled list or an arc — over a dimmed backdrop while the button turns neutral and the plus rotates into ×. Extended mode springs between a pill and a circle; an optional pulse ring draws the eye on empty states.8 variants
Sign in to try it live
Morphing Button GroupProNewA row of buttons that morphs between sets: one button splits into two, two join into one, and a button that changes its label cross-fades it while it stretches. Ships with SignatureSheet, the pattern it was made for — a "Sign" pill that grows into a signing card whose Cancel splits into Reset + Confirm once you draw, and Confirm stretches into "Confirm Signature" before the card glides back down.2 variants
Sign in to try it live
QR Code ButtonProNewA "Show QR Code" pill that swells under your finger and morphs, on a smooth ease, into a white card holding a real, scannable QR code — Copy and close below it. The code is encoded inside the component (byte mode, error correction M, every version up to 40) and drawn as one crisp SVG path, so there's no QR library to install.3 variants
Sign in to try it live
Slide to ConfirmProSlide-to-pay track: drag the thumb and a glowing trail follows it towards a target that lights up, with haptic ticks along the way. Every look follows the accent as one solid colour (with an opt-in gradient variant); success draws a check, a failed onConfirm shakes the track and slides back.7 variants
Stateful ButtonA button that walks through idle, loading, success and error: the label rolls letter by letter to the next text while the width springs to fit it. A spinner, a self-drawing check or a shaking cross grows in beside the label, and it drives itself when onPress returns a Promise.5 variants

Feedback6

AlertInline banner with a living icon that draws itself inside a halo, a soft light-leak glow of its tone, and primary + secondary actions. Optional auto-dismiss shows the time left as a hairline draining along the bottom (pauses while touched), and on dismiss it collapses smoothly so content below glides up.6 variants
Sign in to try it live
Drip ToastProToasts that drip out of the top of the screen — on an iPhone, straight out of the Dynamic Island — on a liquid strand that pinches off as the pill settles. A toast with a description or action lets a card drop out of the pill through a liquid neck, folds it back, and is sucked up into the edge when it leaves. mode="single" keeps one pill that gulps the old toast and drips out the next, so drip.promise() turns its spinner straight into the success or error card.4 variants
ProgressSolid bar in the accent colour with a soft glowing head that rides the fill (or sweeps when indeterminate, or carries animated stripes), an SVG ring with a glowing arc tip whose percentage counts up and morphs into a drawn check, and segments that pop as they fill while the current step pulses. Reaching max plays a short success flash.7 variants
SkeletonLoading placeholders where one soft, 20°-angled light band sweeps the whole screen as a single wave (or blocks brighten top-to-bottom, or gently pulse), all from one shared native-driver clock and static under reduce motion. Text, avatar, media, list, feed card and full-screen Nav composites, plus Skeleton.Reveal: the skeleton dissolves, content rises in child by child and the height glides between the two.9 variants
SpinnerA loader pack: the comet ring whose tail breathes as it spins, a staggered dot wave, and ten more — equalizer bars, pulse ripple, orbit, squash-bounce, sine wave, 3×3 grid, typing bubble, counter-rotating arcs, morphing square and an indeterminate line. All native-driver loops, one size/colour/speed API, optional track and an animated-ellipsis label.7 variants
ToastSonner-style toasts with living tone icons: the outline draws itself inside a halo, a light-leak glow spills behind it, and a hairline drains along the bottom as time runs out (paused while touched). toast.promise() closes the spinning arc into the success or error circle before the mark draws in, variant="minimal" gives compact inverted pills (with a second line for the description), and variant="island" turns the Toaster into an iPhone-style Dynamic Island.8 variants

Overlays4

Action SheetNewAn iOS-quality action sheet: grouped rounded cards with hairline separators, an optional title and message, and a separate Cancel card. It springs up over a fading scrim and follows your finger anywhere on the sheet — fling or pull past a third to dismiss, pulling up rubber-bands. Rows highlight on touch with a selection haptic; icons, destructive and disabled options; plus a Material list and a share-sheet grid.5 variants
Bottom SheetDraggable bottom sheet with snap points, a grabber pill that stretches as you drag, rubber-banding past its limits and release-velocity snapping with a haptic tick on each detent. The scrim dims in step with its height, content scrolls once fully expanded, a footer stays pinned at every detent, and the keyboard lifts it. Large radius, hairline edge and a soft layered top shadow.5 variants
DialogA centred alert dialog: the scrim fades in while the card springs from 0.92 to full size, with an optional living tone icon that draws itself in a glowing halo. Modern pill buttons or iOS hairline buttons, side by side or stacked; danger-coloured destructive confirms with a warning haptic, async spinners, a prompt field, and a shake when the confirm is invalid. Use Action Sheet for bottom actions.7 variants
DrawerNewSide navigation drawer that springs in over a fading scrim — or, with variant="push", shrinks the screen into a rounded 0.92 card and slides it aside like modern mail apps. Swipe in from the edge, drag closed from anywhere on the panel with velocity and rubber-banding, and build the panel from DrawerProfile (soft initials avatar, presence, account switcher), DrawerItems with a spring-in accent-tinted active pill and popping count badges, divided section headings and a DrawerFooter meter. Flat theme colours, hairline edges and soft shadows; haptics throughout.4 variants

Display10

AccordionCollapsible sections whose content is measured, so any height springs open smoothly — with a rotating chevron, fade-and-drop content, single or multiple mode, and default, bordered or separated-card styles.4 variants
AvatarPhoto that fades in over soft tinted initials (hue hashed from the name, ink picked for contrast), presence dots, notification badges and a verified seal cut into the edge, a gapped story ring that cross-fades to “seen”, and an AvatarGroup with cut-out borders, a +N chip and a staggered spring-in.8 variants
BadgeStatus labels in solid, soft, outline and dot styles across five tones — when the label changes it rolls over letter by letter, the icon pops, the colour cross-fades and the pill springs to its new width. Plus NotificationBadge with BadgeIconTile/BadgeIcon anchors (or your own children), spring-in counts, and pop on change.5 variants
CardComposable surface — Header, Title, Description, Content, Media, Footer — in default, outline and elevated styles. Pressable cards spring down and can light up with a spotlight that follows your finger or a glowing accent border.4 variants
Sign in to try it live
CarouselProSnapping horizontal carousel where neighbouring slides shrink, fade or tilt in 3D with the scroll position (native driver). Dots, expanding dots or a progress bar, autoplay that pauses while you touch, and a per-slide progress value for your own parallax.6 variants
Grain GradientNewA soft mesh-style gradient — a base colour with blurred colour blobs — finished with real film grain. Twelve palettes or your own colours. Use it as a screen or card background, or behind glass so there is something to refract. GrainOverlay adds the same grain to anything, photos included.3 variants
List ItemNewSettings, contacts and inbox rows: icon tiles, avatars with presence dots, subtitles, values, badges, checks and chevrons, with a UIKit-style press highlight that fades in fast and out slow. ListGroup gives you the iOS inset-grouped card with headers, footers and separators that line up with the text.5 variants
Sign in to try it live
MapProNewA full map with no API key, no native module and no config plugin: raster tiles drawn by React Native and moved on the UI thread, so it runs in Expo Go, iOS, Android and web. Drag and fling with momentum, pinch around your fingers, double-tap to zoom in, two-finger tap to zoom out. The camera flies like a plane between far places and glides between near ones. Comes with drop-in pins, rating tags, clusters that split as you zoom, a pulsing location dot with a heading beam, routes that draw themselves on, geofence circles and a floating control stack, all themed by the kit and switching to a dark basemap in dark mode.3 variants
Sign in to try it live
Swipeable RowProMail-style list row: drag sideways to reveal actions that fan out and grow with your finger. A full swipe stretches the edge action across the row and fires it — destructive ones slide away and collapse the row. PanResponder only, so it works with a mouse on the web too.3 variants
TimelineNewVertical timeline for order tracking, activity feeds, travel logs and release history, in the preview's solid accent colour. Items rise in, then the connector fills down to the current step: done dots draw their check as the line arrives, the current dot pulses, upcoming dots stay hollow on a dotted track, and failures draw a red cross. The scroll variant ties the fill to the scroll position, lighting each node as the line reaches it. Entries can carry photo galleries, tags and links.7 variants

Navigation3

Bottom NavNewBottom navigation in five looks — minimal dot, floating capsule, expanding pill, notched centre FAB and top indicator with a spotlight. A liquid indicator stretches between tabs (leading edge first, trailing edge catching up), icons morph from outline to filled with a spring and a lift, active labels rise in, badges pop, the solid accent action button glows softly, and every change ticks a haptic.6 variants
Progress StepsNewMulti-step progress for checkout and onboarding. Completed steps pop and draw their check, the current step glows with a breathing ring, upcoming steps stay hollow; advance and the connector pours the accent into the next step with a selection tick. Horizontal with labels, vertical with descriptions, or a compact "Step 2 of 4" segmented bar.5 variants
TabsUnderline tabs with swipeable content panes. The underline is measured to each label and moves like liquid — leading edge first, trailing edge catching up — and follows your finger while you drag the panes, with rubber-band resistance at the ends. Count badges pop, the bar scrolls and centres the active tab once tabs overflow, and every change ticks a haptic.4 variants

Number TickerProAn odometer for your numbers — every digit rolls on its own spring (up when the value grows, down when it shrinks), staggered right to left, with a green/red colour flash, separators, decimals, prefix and suffix.4 variants
Sign in to try it live
Orb RevealProNewAn onboarding hero built around a thick liquid-glass orb. Hold it and it swells while a deep blue smile of light glows through it; drag it up and it shrinks into a glass button, showing your title through the lens on the way — magnified in the middle, mirrored around the bevel, with a rainbow fringe — then glass marbles fountain out of it into a heart. Drag it back down and the marbles float away.2 variants
Text AnimationFive text effects in one component: words rising on a soft spring, a looping shimmer for "Thinking…" states, letters rolling between values, a glyph scramble and a typewriter with a caret.
